title: Undead
intro: Census phase: vanilla data, plus the Ehlnofey target band of each record. Every undead family placed or spawned as an enemy, draugr included (user, 2026-09-30). An undead that exists only as a summon is under Conjured. The sub-groups move here one at a time: Vampires, Draugr, Skeletons, Ghosts and Dragon Priests so far; Ash and the Creation Club undead (Zombies, Ayleid Undead) are still to come.

families.holds: the eight Skyrim priests, Vahlok the Jailor, the three Solstheim acolytes (Ahzidal, Dukaan, Zahkriisos) and the generic Dragon Priest
